title: Original manuscript of Gitanjali - Rabindranath Tagore - Rothenstein collection.pdf, notebook page numbered '20' (printed folio '11')
licenseTag: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CC0-equivalent per file page)
licenseBasis: File page states public domain because the author (Tagore) died in 1941 and the manuscript predates 1931. Source: Rothenstein Papers collection, Houghton Library, Harvard University -- Tagore's autograph manuscript, given to William Rothenstein in London in 1912.
notes: This is page 25 of the 184-page PDF (Commons' internal page-thumbnail numbering), rendered via the MediaWiki PDF page-thumbnail endpoint at the 960px-wide tier (960px was the only thumbnail width Commons would render on demand for this file; larger widths returned HTTP 400). Full source PDF is 175.95MB / 184 pages at native ~1185x1754px per page; this is a downsampled render, not the full-resolution scan. Visually confirmed this specific page shows Tagore's characteristic handwritten revision marks: a word crossed out with 'meet' inserted above the line, another crossed-out word replaced inline with 'sorrow', and a caret-inserted 'forget'. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: this manuscript is Tagore's own ENGLISH-language autograph translation of Gitanjali (the version he brought to London in 1912), not a Bengali-script manuscript -- no Bengali-script Gitanjali manuscript scan with visible revision marks was located on Commons. The requested ideal (Bengali-script Gitanjali manuscript with revisions) was not found; this English-language autograph with revisions was substituted as the closest verified match.
